claim: export_rows() opens a file handle without closing it on the error path, leaking descriptors under repeated failures.
counterevidence: Process may be short-lived so the leak is bounded; confirm whether export_rows runs in a long-lived worker.
evidence: src/app/exporter.py calls open() then returns early on a validation error before close()
no context manager (with-statement) wraps the handle

evidence_fields.root_cause: File handle is not released on the early-return error path.
evidence_fields.leak_or_exhaustion_path: repeated export failures each leak one descriptor until the process hits its fd limit

risk_score.risk_reason: Resource leak can degrade a long-lived process; fix is a local context manager.

recommendation: Wrap the handle in a context manager so it closes on every path.
title: Leaked file descriptor on export error path
